_meta.note: Everything the SERVER sends an observer: OTP codes, Telegram pings, push notifications and rows in the in-app alert feed. Separate from app/i18n/ — that one is what the browser renders, and the server cannot read localStorage. Placeholders are {name}; a missing one is left as literal braces so the hole is visible rather than silently swallowed.
_meta.notTranslated: Data fragments — a polling-unit code, a party name, a vote count, an incident kind, a status slug — are composed by the caller and never keyed. Only sentences live here.
